Leo Martins
Data Engineer

Experience:

  Modelled reporting tables in sql and documented every column with its owning team.
  Added data quality checks that failed loudly instead of publishing partial tables.

Education:
- B.S. Statistics, Riverside University (2021)

Skills: python sql airflow warehouse etl pandas data quality testing

# Ingest Pipeline
Batch ingestion for vendor data extracts.

## Overview
An airflow managed etl pipeline written in python that loads vendor extracts into a warehouse.
Each run is idempotent so a replay never duplicates rows in the target tables.

## Data Quality
Every table is checked for row counts, null rates and freshness before it is published.
A failing check stops the pipeline rather than letting partial data reach downstream reports.

## Scheduling
Dags are scheduled nightly with explicit retries and alerting on repeated failure.
Backfills are run through the same code path as scheduled runs to avoid drift.

## Testing
Transforms are covered by pytest cases built on small fixture frames rather than production extracts.

# Metrics Warehouse
Reporting models for company metrics.

## Overview
A layered sql warehouse that turns raw ingested tables into reviewed reporting models.
Staging, intermediate and mart layers are kept separate so lineage stays readable.

## Documentation
Every model carries a description, an owning team and a freshness expectation.
Undocumented columns fail the build, which keeps the catalogue trustworthy.

## Review
Model changes require a pull request with sample query output attached for review.
